about_the_game:
This is the official soundtrack for Good Morning My Darling, composed by Kova.

Please Note:

The game is entirely free, and contains all of the music featured in this soundtrack, other than the Good Morning Trailer, which is included as a Bonus.

Most of the tracks listed here loop once throughout their playtime.

If you enjoyed the game, and would like to show your support, consider purchasing this soundtrack.

It will be greatly appreciated!
